transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I keep getting these nagging thoughts that I forgot something important. Like maybe I left my aunt’s medicine out wrong, or didn’t set up materials in my classroom safely. Even when I’m pretty sure I handled it, the doubt just keeps coming back.
When those doubts pop up, do you feel driven to repeatedly check or redo things to make sure everything is okay?

Yes. Before I leave home or my classroom, I’ll check the same things a few times—the pill organizer, the stove, my lesson plans. Sometimes I just replay in my head what I did. I keep doing it until I feel calm enough to leave, even though it can make me late.
Aside from these doubts about checking and safety, do you find yourself constantly worrying about many other everyday areas of your life, like finances, health, or your family?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself worrying about lots of different things like that all the time.
